limitations: A same-type list button cannot remove a sole list selected as the entire document in the reference; this is reproduced as a limitation, not a working removal path
The 20MB attachment hint is not enforced: the demo accepts generated 20,000,000-byte and 20MiB+1-byte payloads with PDF MIME/extensions, and a text file. PDF syntax validity is not tested
A native chooser accept attribute is a suggestion filter; Playwright setFiles bypasses that filter and does not prove that an OS dialog visually allowed selecting a text file
Rich text Save has no persistence handler and its character count remains a dash
The selected screenshot states contain small nonzero pixel differences; complete parity across all values, sizes and animation frames is not asserted
No external upload, business API, or server persistence outcome is asserted
